issues.what: dev:web script uses ELECTRON_DISABLE=true (Unix syntax) — will fail on Windows without cross-env
issues.how_to_fix: Add cross-env as devDependency: "dev:web": "cross-env ELECTRON_DISABLE=true vite"

issues.what: fallbackSend param _partial is unused (prefixed with _ so linter OK, but dead param)
issues.how_to_fix: Remove _partial parameter or use it to prepend partial streaming content to the fallback response

issues.what: import.meta.url in CJS output (rollup output format is cjs in vite.config.ts line 22) — may fail at runtime in Electron
issues.how_to_fix: Use __dirname directly in CJS context, or switch output format to ESM for Electron main
